description: Read a path from OPA's data hierarchy. A `path` is read as dotted (`users.alice`) unless it contains a slash, in which case slash is the only separator (`users/alice`), so a key such as `example.com` is addressable as `hosts/example.com`. Pass `segments` instead when a key contains both.

segments.description: Path as literal key segments, e.g. ["labels", "app.kubernetes.io/name"]. Use instead of `path` when a key contains a dot or a slash.

name: opa_get_data
title: Read data from OPA
